column2: Taʿruju l-malāʾikatu walrrūḥu ʾilayhi fi yawmin kāna miqdāruhu khamsīna ʾalfa sanat
Yubaṣṣarūnahum yawaddu l-mujrimu law yaftadi min ʿadhābi yawmiʾidhin bibanīh
Waman fi l-ʾarḍi jamīʿan thumma yunjīh
Walladhīna hum min ʿadhābi rabbihim mushfiqūn
ʾillā ʿalā ʾazwājihim ʾaw mā malakat ʾaymānuhum faʾinnahum ghayru malūmīn
Famani btaghā warāʾa dhālika faʾūlāʾika humu l-ʿādūn
ʾayaṭmaʿu kullu mriʾin minhum ʾan yudkhala jannata naʿīm
Falā ʾuqsimu birabbi l-mashāriqi walmaghāribi ʾinnā laqādirūn
ʿalā ʾan nubaddila khayran minhum wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīn
Fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu ladhi yūʿadūn
Yawma yakhrujūna mina l-ʾajdāthi sirāʿan kaʾannahum ʾilā nuṣubin yūfiḍūn
Khāshiʿatan ʾabṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhālika l-yawmu ladhi kānū yūʿadūn
